name: Sunlight
description: Shadows at any moment, or hours of direct sun over a day

about.purpose: Shows shadows at any moment, the golden hour of a morning or evening, or sun hours over a day: the clearest way to discuss overshadowing and the light of a place.
questions: Does a courtyard or school yard get enough sun under Boverket's guidance or BRE?
How does a proposal change sun and shade on squares and courtyards?
Which places get sun in the morning, at lunch, in winter?
Where does the evening sun still reach, and where is the warm light at golden hour?
limits: Shadows fall on the ground; sun on facades is planned
Buildings and trees added or taken away from phones last until Sunlight closes; they are not saved
Uses the site's buildings and trees for shadows

controls.label: Show
controls.help: Shadows at one moment, the hours of direct sun over a day, or the three seasons side by side.

controls.label: Rule
controls.help: Which daylight rule open ground is judged by. Each sets its own day, hours and share, which can then be changed.

controls.label: Sun a place needs
controls.help: Hours of direct sun a place needs to pass. Boverket's guidance asks 5 h between 9 and 17 at the equinox; BRE asks 2 h on 21 March.

controls.label: Share of open ground that must pass
controls.help: How much of the ground outside buildings needs that much sun for the area to pass.

controls.label: Day
controls.help: The day the sun is worked out for. Midsummer, the equinox and midwinter are one tap.

controls.label: Time of day
controls.help: The moment the shadows are drawn for, in the table's own time zone.

controls.label: Shadow trails over the day
controls.help: Every shadow of the day at once, faint, so you see where shade sweeps across.

controls.label: Animate the day
controls.help: Runs through the day on its own, sunrise to sunset.

controls.label: Play speed
controls.help: How fast the day plays. A winter day and night take about 13 seconds at Normal.

controls.label: Sun during
controls.help: Which part of the day the sun hours count.

controls.label: Season on the table
controls.help: Which season the table shows while the controller compares all three.

controls.label: Flag areas with less sun than
controls.help: Places with fewer hours of sun than this are marked, as planning rules ask.

controls.label: Sun path on the table
controls.help: The sun's path across the sky, drawn around the table.

controls.label: Light the 3D model
controls.help: Lights the walls and roofs of the 3D model from the sun's direction.

controls.label: Trees cast shade
controls.help: Trees in the table's data cast shade as well as buildings.

controls.label: Tree shade in its own colour
New building height
controls.help: How tall a building drawn on a phone stands. Changes from phones are not saved and go when Sunlight closes.

controls.label: Opacity
controls.help: How strongly the layer draws over the map.

tools.label: How much sun here?
tools.help: Tap a place to see how many hours of sun it gets.

tools.label: Add a building
tools.help: Draw a new building's outline and see the shade it casts.

tools.label: Plant a tree
tools.help: Tap where a new tree should stand.

tools.label: Take a building or tree away
tools.help: Tap a building or tree to see the place without it.
